title: Career roadmap · Cloud Architect
summary: A four-year engineering path focused on computer networks, operating systems, cloud platforms, distributed systems, infrastructure automation, security, containers and cloud architecture.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme beginning in 2026 and graduating around 2030.

about.label: Career-route check
about.text: Cloud Architect is a long-term architecture role. A B.Tech/B.E. can provide the foundation, but most Cloud Architect positions require substantial hands-on engineering and cloud experience rather than being a typical first job.

blocks.label: 4-year honours variant
blocks.text: Use the additional honours year for advanced distributed systems, multi-cloud architecture, cloud security, platform engineering, research or an extended cloud-engineering internship.

rows.text: IaC, CI/CD, IAM, security, policy automation

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Move from managing individual cloud resources to designing complete platforms. Develop expertise in distributed systems, reliability, security, FinOps, platform engineering, AI infrastructure and multi-cloud/hybrid-cloud decision-making.
